items.place: New Delhi · Allahabad and Rajasthan High Courts
items.headline: Websites blocked on forged court orders
items.text: The telecom department ordered 129 websites blocked on two forged High Court orders, Reuters reported. The Allahabad High Court's complaint led to a police FIR; the department did not respond.

photo.alt: A large cream stone court building with a pediment, red-tiled roofs and an Indian flag, behind lawns and potted plants.
photo.caption: The Allahabad High Court in Prayagraj, in 2009; a forged order in its name was used to block websites.

items.place: Indian embassy, Oslo · Bharat Summit, Hyderabad
items.headline: Norwegian journalist's India visa cancelled
items.text: Dagsavisen journalist Helle Lyng Svendsen says India's Oslo embassy cancelled her visa minutes before she left to speak on press freedom in Hyderabad. The ministries and embassy had not commented.

photo.alt: A white modernist building with a garage, a small lawn and an Indian flag on a pole by the entrance.
photo.caption: The Embassy of India in Oslo, Norway, in 2015.

items.headline: Activists say police held them before smog protest
items.text: A workers' party says Delhi Police put several activists under house arrest to stop a peaceful protest over pollution on Wednesday. No police response was reported.

photo.alt: Auto-rickshaws, cycle-rickshaws and cars on a road under thick grey smog, with trees fading into the haze.
photo.caption: Smog over Chelmsford Road, New Delhi, on 31 December 2017.

items.headline: Court: inviting public debate is not enmity
items.text: The Sikkim High Court quashed an FIR and chargesheet over an invitation to a public consultation on Darjeeling-Sikkim unification, holding it did not promote enmity. It called the logo use "mischievous".

photo.alt: A dense hillside town of colourful multi-storey buildings along a winding road, seen from above, with forested hills behind.
photo.caption: Gangtok, Sikkim's capital, seen from the ropeway in 2018.

items.headline: Group flags Muslim voter deletions in Karnataka
items.text: A Muslim community body says 22.7% of Muslim voters were deleted in 64 seats during the roll revision, against 20.2% of others, citing an analysis of booth data. No Election Commission response was reported.

photo.alt: Men, women and children stand in a queue on the veranda of an old school building used as a polling booth.
photo.caption: Voters queue at a polling booth in Bengaluru during the 2014 general election.

items.place: Khan Younis and Gaza City, Gaza
items.headline: Strike hits Gaza medical complex; nine killed
items.text: At least nine were killed across Gaza, four in a strike at Khan Younis's Nasser Medical Complex, civil defence said, and two brothers in a Sheikh Radwan tent. No Israeli military comment was reported.

photo.alt: A dirt road between collapsed and badly damaged multi-storey buildings and piles of rubble.
photo.caption: Destroyed buildings in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan district in 2025. Wednesday's strikes hit Rafah and Khan Younis.

items.headline: UN: 'No more delay' on Gaza winter aid
items.text: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher said waiting for a new Israeli government is "not an acceptable excuse" to delay winter aid; UNICEF says rain hit 106,000 people. Tents need Israeli permits, the UN says.

photo.alt: A canvas tent with a mattress and plastic chairs in front, pitched among the concrete rubble of collapsed buildings.
photo.caption: A tent set up by a homeowner among the rubble of his house in Gaza, January 2025.

items.headline: UN survey: most Sudanese households lack livelihoods
items.text: An IOM survey of 23,736 households found 68% have unmet livelihood needs, 83% among displaced families, and 98% face rising prices. Three South Kordofan localities could not be surveyed.

photo.alt: A street with a Sudapost sign over a gateway, small shops, parked cars and a few people walking on a sandy road.
photo.caption: A market street in Nyala, South Darfur, in 2012, before the war.

items.headline: OCHA: 71 aid workers killed in Sudan, 2025
items.text: At least 71 aid workers were killed and 28 injured in Sudan in 2025, OCHA's annual report says; more than 180 health facilities lost funding.

photo.alt: Makeshift shelters of sticks, cloth and plastic on dry red ground under a blue sky.
photo.caption: Makeshift shelters at Intifada transit camp near Nyala, South Darfur.

items.headline: HRW: 2,300 reported deaths in junta custody
items.text: More than 32,000 people have been arrested for opposing military rule and at least 2,300 reportedly died in custody, HRW says before the ASEAN summit. No junta response was reported.

photo.alt: A closed iron gate between white pillars, with signboards on either side, a parked car and trees behind.
photo.caption: The main gate of Insein Prison, Yangon, in 2013.

items.headline: Lebanon: over a million face food shortages
items.text: More than one million people, nearly a quarter of Lebanon, face acute food shortages, FAO, WFP and the agriculture ministry said, rising to 1.15 million by mid-2027.

focus.title: Palestine: Gaza and the West Bank
focus.dek: A year into the October 2025 ceasefire, Gaza's health ministry counts 1,622 killed since the truce; storms flood tent camps, and the UN says winter aid is being delayed.
focus.alt: A dirt road between collapsed and badly damaged multi-storey buildings and piles of rubble.
